prayerAnatomy.opening: Same short preparatory invocation from Day 1, explicitly reused in Days 2–9
prayerAnatomy.meditationPerDay: One extended historical meditation, generally three marked contemplation points
prayerAnatomy.actPerDay: A distinct Act, not replaceable by a generic one
prayerAnatomy.repeatedAspirations: Shared concluding aspirations to the Holy Face
prayerAnatomy.repeatedCollect: Shared closing prayer to God almighty and merciful
prayerAnatomy.layoutPolicy: Retain original order; show opening, complete day meditation, distinct act, virtue, bouquet, aspirations, collect. Never present partial meditation as the whole historical text.

datePolicy.historicalObservedContext: Traditionally prayed in preparation for the Holy Face feast on Shrove Tuesday
datePolicy.suggestion: Calendar-driven nine-day preparation ending the Monday before Shrove Tuesday, computed from the app's 1962 calendar; no fixed 20–28 February every year
datePolicy.voluntary: May also be undertaken at another time
